recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-31249 unless a future work group decision changes the SearchParameter.processingMode requirement itself.
issue_request: FHIR-31249 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I R5 technical correction for SearchParameter. It requested removing the spd-1 condition from SearchParameter.expression because spd-1 was then an xpath/xpathUsage invariant unrelated to expression.
initial_application: Commit 4a2e1d85ae54ff4d7f68ec5af9591eca21029e80, merged through HL7/fhir#1960, deleted the spd-1 condition from SearchParameter.expression while spd-1 still referenced xpath/xpathUsage. That matched the seed issue's requested correction.
additional_context: Later Published/Persuasive with Modification issue FHIR-32530 removed SearchParameter.xpath, renamed xpathUsage to processingMode, and revised spd-1 to drive off expression/processingMode. Current source/fhir.ini keeps SearchParameter active, and source/searchparameter/structuredefinition-SearchParameter.xml now defines spd-1 as expression.empty() or processingMode.exists() with conditions on both SearchParameter.expression and SearchParameter.processingMode. FHIR-32530 already has a separate combined-branch reconciliation commit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Removing spd-1 from SearchParameter.expression now would be wrong because the current invariant is intentionally about expression and processingMode, not the obsolete xpath rule that FHIR-31249 corrected.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive with Modification SearchParameter issue that removed xpath, renamed xpathUsage to processingMode, and intentionally revised spd-1 to be about expression/processingMode.
